premise: The retained informational card correctly describes multiply-and-XOR and netstandard2.0 compatibility; it is not misrepresented as a plain symmetric field-XOR bug.

identityAndHash.type: Internal sealed ServiceOverrideCallsite with four getter-only string values, produced from semantic symbols and constant method name.
identityAndHash.equality: Typed Equals compares TypeFullyQualifiedName and MethodName; null is false. Object Equals delegates to it. Hash uses those same two values.
identityAndHash.contract: Equal values have equal hashes by the source expression; collisions for unequal values are permitted, not defect or performance evidence.
identityAndHash.ordinaryInputQualification: The two captured normal registrations use the same TestOverrides type with FakeWeather and LockableWeather methods. With a fixed left hash, XOR is bijective over raw right hash values. This restricted algebra is not actual string hashes/bucket distribution, zero collisions, a universal input bound or performance.

owningProducer: StartupHookGenerator IIncrementalGenerator syntax predicate selects ConfigureServices names; semantic transform requires actual ServerStartOptions method, outside forwarding overload implementation.
Generic type argument or non-generic typeof plus constant string/nameof must resolve to a valid static single-IServiceCollection target method before constructing a callsite.

The shipping Components.Testing package includes the generator as an analyzer; external compilation consumers are possible. It is not dismissed as merely an unshipped unit-test helper.
